components.text: The Rune of Self Sacrifice increases the amount of $(blood)Life Essence$() gained in the Blood Altar through means that use a player's health. Each rune gives a bonus of +10% additively per rune.

With Netherite Scrap and Hellforged Parts, you can upgrade a Rune of Self Sacrifice to its augmented form, increasing the bonus to an additive +20% per rune. If you change your mind, you can undo the upgrade in the Alchemical Reaction Chamber (ARC).
